attchmntText: State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: State Bank of India will interact with institutional investors in Singapore through one-on-one and group meetings. Representatives will attend the BofA India Corporate Day organized by Bank of America on 17.11.2026 from 06:30 AM to 3:00 PM IST. They will also participate in the MS Twenty-Fifth Annual Asia Pacific Summit organized by Morgan Stanley on 18.11.2026 from 07:00 AM to 3:00 PM IST. The company confirms that only information available in the public domain will be shared with investors and analysts during these interactions. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A Part A of Schedule III to SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: State Bank Of India has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: State Bank of India filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 Analyst Meet held on 03.11.2026. The bank reported a net profit of Rs. 23,038 crore and an operating profit of Rs. 34,226 crore. Domestic net interest margin improved to 3.11%. Total business aggregated Rs. 115 trillion, with deposits at Rs. 63 trillion and advances crossing Rs. 52 trillion. Gross NPA ratio stood at 1.39%, and the provision coverage ratio was 74%. Capital adequacy was 16.09%. The listing of SBI Funds Management Limited occurred during the quarter. Chairman C.S. Setty highlighted digital initiatives including Project SARAL, Re-KYC, and Seva Sarathi. YONO registrations exceeded 11 crores.
